items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: But we would always know that he was going to be there and we'd play for him right off the top of our heads.

ctx.x: What kind of a singer was he? What kind of songs did he sing?

He played the piano and sang whatever kind of songs that you want to hear according to your mood, which a singer in that day and age had to do. You had to be what was called an entertainer, not just a singer. You were an entertainer. Well, that type of guy was -- and then, he would always, when Bojangles Robinson came in town, he would always come by and do his act, strictly because he liked to be a part of the scene. Wherever he was, he would come around. Ethel Waters would come in. She would sing.
Would Bojangles be appearing in a theater?
